For restaurants, caterers, cafés and local service businesses, the most useful content often starts with the work itself. A dish coming together. A thoughtful detail. A service explained clearly.

My expertise brings together social media content, SEO/AEO and digital presence support. I connect what you publish with the information customers need to understand your business and make an inquiry.

Clear responsibilities, from the start.

You share priorities, help prepare for shoots and review content. The service handles the agreed planning, production and publishing. Before work begins, we agree on deliverables, communication and approvals.

Trusted by many companies, with 10+ years of experience managing Government of Canada social media accounts with 100K+ followers.

Meet Samuel Burke

I’m Samuel, founder of LOCAL / SOCIAL and a communications and marketing specialist with experience in government and small business. My background spans social media, web content, community building and engagement analytics.

My local experience includes OttawaEvents, Ottawa.Catering and Ad Mare Seafood. I bring that perspective to content that reflects how local businesses work and what their customers need.

I hold an honours degree in Communication Studies from Carleton University and a graduate certificate in Entrepreneurship Acceleration from Algonquin College.
